about: A template in another file applied with #show: project.with(...); its string arguments print on the title

files.content:
#import "template.typ": project
#show: project.with(title: "Migration of Cranes", authors: ("Ada Lin", "Борис Ким"))

= Background

Cranes fly south in autumn.

They return in spring.

#let project(title: "", authors: (), body) = {
  set document(title: title)
  align(center, text(17pt, weight: "bold", title))
  align(center, authors.join(", "))
  [Prepared for the field station.]
  body
}
